s: Levi is set apart by the LORD your God (to bear the ark, minister, and bless)
q: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

s: Levi has inheritance the LORD your God (no portion with its brothers)
q: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance

s: the LORD your God cares for Canaan (his eyes are always on it all year)
q: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

s: Israelites (addressees of Moses) set before them blessing and curse (blessing for obedience, curse for disobedience)
q: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

s: Egypt has king Pharaoh
q: Pharaoh the king of Egypt

s: Egypt differs from Canaan (Egypt is irrigated by foot; the promised land drinks rain)
q: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

s: Canaan has terrain hills and valleys
q: the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

s: Canaan is described as flowing with milk and honey
q: a land flowing with milk and honey.

s: Canaan has boundary Euphrates (eastern border, along with the wilderness and Lebanon)
q: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

s: Canaan has boundary western sea (western border)
q: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

s: Canaan is located Jordan (across the Jordan, in the land of the Canaanites)
q: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

s: blessing and curse is set on Mount Gerizim (the blessing)
q: you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

s: blessing and curse is set on Mount Ebal (the curse)
q: you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

s: the LORD your God gives rain (in its season, if Israelites obey)
q: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain

s: blessing and curse is conditioned on commandments, statutes, and ordinances (blessing if obeyed, curse if not)
q: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;

s: Mount Gerizim is located Jordan (beyond the Jordan, near the oaks of Moreh)
q: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

s: the LORD your God destroyed army of Egypt (made the Red Sea overflow them as they pursued)
q: how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how the LORD has destroyed them to this day

s: the LORD your God swore to give land to fathers of Israel (patriarchs) (and to their offspring)
q: the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring

s: the LORD your God will drive out nations of the land (if Israelites keep all the commandments)
q: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you

s: Israelites (addressees of Moses) commanded to love the LORD your God
q: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

s: Israelites (addressees of Moses) commanded to keep commandments, statutes, and ordinances (always)
q: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

s: Israelites (addressees of Moses) witnessed Egypt (the LORD's signs and works in the middle of Egypt)
q: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

s: Israelites (addressees of Moses) will possess Canaan (they are about to cross the Jordan)
q: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

s: the LORD your God is god of Israel (God of their fathers)
q: the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess

s: Israel must not add to or subtract from the LORD your God (his commands)
q: You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

s: Levites has no portion Israel (no inheritance with them)
q: the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

s: Levites must not be forsaken by Israel (as long as they live in the land)
q: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

s: place the LORD shall choose is location for offerings and sacrifices (only permitted place to offer burnt offerings)
q: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings

s: place the LORD shall choose involves going over the Jordan and dwelling in the land the LORD causes them to inherit
q: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit

s: pagan worship sites and objects is located at high mountains, hills, under green trees (places where nations served their gods)
q: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

s: eating of meat is permitted within all gates (according to desire, clean and unclean alike)
q: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul

s: blood is the life (must not be eaten with the meat)
q: for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

s: offerings and sacrifices must be eaten at place the LORD shall choose (tithes, firstborn, vows, free will offerings, not within gates)
q: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose

s: nations of the land practice child sacrifice (burn sons and daughters to their gods)
q: for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

s: the LORD your God gives land (to the Israelites to possess)
q: which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

s: the LORD your God chooses place the LORD shall choose (to put his name there)
q: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there

s: the LORD your God hates child sacrifice (abomination done by nations to their gods)
q: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

s: the LORD your God forbids pagan worship sites and objects (Israelites must not worship him in the pagan manner)
q: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

s: Israel must destroy pagan worship sites and objects (altars, pillars, Asherah poles, engraved images)
q: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire.

s: Israel will dispossess nations of the land (in the promised land)
q: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

s: Israel must not eat blood (must pour it out on the earth like water)
q: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

s: Israel must bring offerings to place the LORD shall choose (burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, vows)
q: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

s: the LORD your God brought out Israel (from Egypt, the house of bondage)
q: who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage

s: Israel must serve the LORD your God (commanded duty, cling to him)
q: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

s: secret enticer (close relative or friend) is subject of death penalty for idolatry (stoning, first by the hand of the one enticed)
q: you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

s: secret enticer (close relative or friend) is a brother, son, daughter, wife or friend (close relation who entices secretly)
q: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly

s: idolatrous city is subject of death penalty for idolatry (inhabitants struck by sword, city burned, if proven true)
q: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly

s: idolatrous city has status heap forever (never rebuilt)
q: It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

s: idolatrous city was led astray by wicked fellows (drawn to serve other gods)
q: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city

s: death penalty for idolatry has method stoning (for an individual enticer)
q: You shall stone him to death with stones

s: death penalty for idolatry has purpose deterrence (all Israel hears and fears)
q: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

s: the LORD your God tests Israel (via a prophet whose sign comes to pass, to know whether they love him wholeheartedly)
q: for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

s: the LORD your God gives idolatrous city (cities given to Israel to dwell in)
q: one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there

s: the LORD your God has sworn to fathers of Israel (oath to multiply Israel)
q: multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers

s: the LORD your God issues commandments, statutes, and ordinances
q: to keep all his commandments which I command you today

s: prophet or dreamer of dreams is subject of death penalty for idolatry (for speaking rebellion against the LORD)
q: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God

s: prophet or dreamer of dreams gives sign or wonder (may come to pass, yet must not be heeded when urging other gods)
q: he gives you a sign or a wonder

s: other gods are unknown to Israel (also unknown to their fathers)
q: which you have not known, you, nor your fathers

s: other gods belong to peoples around Israel (gods of surrounding and distant peoples)
q: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you

s: Israel is a children of the LORD your God
q: You are the children of the LORD your God.

s: unclean animals includes pig (split hoof but doesn't chew cud)
q: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

s: unclean animals has rule no eating or touching carcasses (stated for the pig)
q: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

s: dietary laws prohibits eating anything that dies of itself (may be given or sold to a foreigner)
q: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner

s: dietary laws prohibits boiling a young goat in its mother's milk
q: You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

s: Israel is a holy people (to the LORD your God)
q: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God

s: tithe consists of increase of seed from the field (yearly)
q: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

s: tithe is eaten at place the LORD shall choose (before the LORD)
q: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil

s: tithe purpose learn to fear the LORD
q: that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

s: tithe may be converted to money (if the way is too long)
q: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

s: tithe is stored within gates (Israelite towns) (every third year)
q: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

s: place the LORD shall choose is chosen by the LORD your God (to dwell his name)
q: in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell

s: Levites has status no portion or inheritance (with the Israelites)
q: for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

s: Levites lives in gates (Israelite towns)
q: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates

s: Levites receives tithe (every third year, with foreigner, fatherless, widow)
q: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied

s: the LORD your God chooses Israel (as his own possession, above all peoples)
q: the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

s: Israel is forbidden to cut themselves (for the dead)
q: You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

s: Israel is forbidden to eat abominable thing
q: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

s: clean animals has trait split hoof and chews the cud (both required)
q: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

s: clean animals includes ox
q: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

s: clean animals includes deer
q: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

s: unclean animals includes camel (chews cud but doesn't part hoof)
q: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

s: seventh-year release of debts occurs every seven years
q: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

s: firstborn of the herd and flock are dedicated to the LORD your God (from herd and flock)
q: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God.

s: firstborn of the herd and flock are exempt from work and shearing (herd firstborn not worked, flock firstborn not sheared)
q: You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

s: firstborn of the herd and flock are eaten at place the LORD shall choose (year by year, by owner and household)
q: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

s: firstborn of the herd and flock are not sacrificed if defective (lame, blind or any defect)
q: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

s: seventh-year release of debts requires creditor (must release what he lent to his neighbor)
q: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor.

s: seventh-year release of debts is proclaimed by the LORD your God (called the LORD's release)
q: because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.

s: seventh-year release of debts does not apply to foreigner (payment may be required of a foreigner)
q: Of a foreigner you may require it;

s: the LORD your God promises to bless Israelites (will lend to many nations but not borrow, will rule many nations)
q: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you.

s: the LORD your God gives land to Israelites (as an inheritance to possess)
q: the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess

s: the LORD your God redeemed Israelites (from slavery in Egypt)
q: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you.

s: release of slaves in the seventh year requires liberal provision (from flock, threshing floor and wine press)
q: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press.

s: release of slaves in the seventh year is grounded in Egypt (remembering slavery in Egypt)
q: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

s: Passover is observed in Abib
q: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God

s: feast of unleavened bread seventh day observance solemn assembly (no work)
q: On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

s: feast of weeks begins counting seven weeks from first sickle to standing grain
q: From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

s: feast of weeks is kept with free will offering (given according to the LORD's blessing)
q: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand

s: feast of weeks is celebrated at place the LORD shall choose (rejoicing before the LORD)
q: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

s: feast of booths duration seven days
q: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days

s: feast of booths timing after gathering from threshing floor and wine press
q: after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

s: feast of booths is celebrated at place the LORD shall choose
q: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses

s: Israel appear before the lord at feast of unleavened bread, feast of weeks, feast of booths (all males, three times a year, not empty-handed)
q: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths.

s: Israel was slave in Egypt
q: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt.

s: the LORD your God brought out Israel (from Egypt by night)
q: in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

s: Passover is sacrificed at place the LORD shall choose (not within any of the gates)
q: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening

s: the LORD your God gives Canaan (to be inherited)
q: that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

s: the LORD your God hates sacred stone
q: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.

s: place the LORD shall choose purpose dwelling of the LORD's name
q: in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

s: judges and officers are appointed in all gates according to tribes (by the Israelites)
q: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes

s: judges and officers judge with righteous judgment
q: they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

s: justice must not be perverted (no partiality, no bribes)
q: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality.

s: justice is required for living and inheriting the land (follow what is altogether just)
q: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

s: Passover sacrifice time evening at sundown (season of coming out of Egypt)
q: there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

s: Passover is kept for the LORD your God
q: keep the Passover to the LORD your God

s: Passover sacrificial animals flock and herd
q: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd

s: Passover preparation method roasted (eaten in the chosen place)
q: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses.

s: feast of unleavened bread duration seven days (unleavened bread eaten; solemn assembly on the seventh day)
q: You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction

s: feast of unleavened bread commemorates Egypt (departure in haste)
q: for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

s: feast of unleavened bread requires no yeast (within all borders)
q: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days

s: Levitical priests ministers before the LORD your God (stands to minister at the chosen place)
q: the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God

s: judge (those days) gives verdict in hard cases in judgment (binding; not to be departed from right or left)
q: You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

s: Israel must obey Levitical priests (disobedience to priest or judge is punished by death)
q: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die.

s: king is chosen by the LORD your God
q: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves.

s: king must be brother (from among the people's brothers, not a foreigner)
q: You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

s: king must not multiply horses (prohibition)
q: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself

s: king must not multiply wives (so his heart does not turn away)
q: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away.

s: king must not multiply silver and gold (not greatly)
q: He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

s: king must not return people to Egypt (for the sake of horses)
q: nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses;

s: king writes law (his own copy in a book upon taking the throne)
q: he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book

s: idolater (man or woman who serves other gods) receives penalty stoning (after diligent inquiry confirms the act)
q: and you shall stone them to death with stones.

s: king reads law (all the days of his life, to learn to fear the LORD)
q: he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God

s: king rules in children of Israel (in the middle of Israel, with his children)
q: he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

s: the LORD your God gives land (to the people)
q: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you

s: the LORD your God chooses place the LORD shall choose
q: the place which the LORD your God chooses

s: Israel is surrounded by nations (they may wish to have a king like them)
q: I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me

s: idolater (man or woman who serves other gods) transgresses covenant (of the LORD your God)
q: a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

s: idolater (man or woman who serves other gods) serves other gods
q: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them

s: witnesses required number two or three (for a death sentence; one witness is insufficient)
q: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

s: witnesses throw first stones stoning (their hands are first on the condemned)
q: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people.

s: hard cases in judgment is referred to place the LORD shall choose (when too hard for local judgment)
q: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.

s: Levitical priests gives verdict in hard cases in judgment (together with the judge)
q: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

s: Levites has inheritance the LORD your God (in place of a land portion)
q: The LORD is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

s: occult practices includes divination, fortune telling, sorcery, necromancy (also child sacrifice by fire, enchanting, charming, consulting familiar spirits)
q: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

s: occult practices is forbidden to Israel (LORD has not allowed it)
q: but as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you so to do.

s: nations of the land is driven out by the LORD your God (because of their abominations)
q: Because of these abominations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

s: nations of the land listens to occult practices (sorcerers and diviners)
q: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners

s: Israel must listen to prophet (disobedience will be required by the LORD)
q: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

s: Israel is required to be blameless (before the LORD)
q: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.

s: false prophet is a prophet who speaks presumptuously in the LORD's name or in other gods' names
q: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

s: false prophet receives penalty death (for presumptuous speech)
q: that same prophet shall die.”

s: false prophet is identified by unfulfilled predictions (thing does not follow or happen)
q: When a prophet speaks in the LORD’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken.

s: Moses is addressed by the LORD your God (at Horeb, LORD affirmed the people's request)
q: The LORD said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

s: Levites has no portion in Israel (no land inheritance among their brothers)
q: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers.

s: Levites eats the LORD your God (offerings made by fire and his portion)
q: They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion.

s: Levites is a tribe of Levi (priests and Levites together)
q: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel.

s: Levites is chosen by the LORD your God (to stand and minister in the LORD's name, with his sons forever)
q: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the LORD’s name, him and his sons forever.

s: Levites minister at place the LORD shall choose (a Levite who comes there ministers like his brothers)
q: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before the LORD.

s: priests' due consists of shoulder, two cheeks and inner parts (from ox or sheep sacrifices)
q: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

s: priests' due includes first fruits of grain, new wine, oil and fleece (given to the priest)
q: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

s: occult practices is regarded by lord as abomination (whoever does these things)
q: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD.

s: the LORD your God gives land (to Israel to possess)
q: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess.

s: intentional murderer hates neighbor (of the man slayer) (lies in wait and strikes him mortally)
q: if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies

s: witnesses required number two or three (to establish a matter; one witness is not enough)
q: At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

s: false witness receives penalty what he intended for the accused (when judges find he testified falsely)
q: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother.

s: law of retribution states life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot (without pity)
q: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

s: three cities of refuge located in land (in the middle of the land)
q: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess.

s: three cities of refuge serves as refuge for man slayer (unintentional killer) (so that he may flee there and live)
q: that every man slayer may flee there.

s: three cities of refuge has additional cities three more (if the border is enlarged and the commandment is kept)
q: then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

s: three cities of refuge purpose prevent shedding of innocent blood
q: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) kills neighbor (of the man slayer) (unintentionally, without prior hatred)
q: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) is not worthy of death (because he did not hate his neighbor previously)
q: even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

s: avenger of blood may pursue man slayer (unintentional killer) (in hot anger, if no refuge city existed)
q: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him

s: intentional murderer is delivered to avenger of blood (by the elders of his city, to die; no refuge granted)
q: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

s: Moses speaks to Israel (beyond the Jordan in the wilderness)
q: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness

s: the LORD your God carries Israel (as a man carries his son in the wilderness)
q: the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went

s: Horeb is distance from Kadesh Barnea (eleven days' journey by way of Mount Seir)
q: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

s: hill country of the Amorites is inhabited by Amorites
q: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country

s: Canaan extends to Euphrates (Lebanon as far as the great river)
q: and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

s: twelve spies consists of twelve men (one man for every tribe)
q: I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

s: Caleb is child of Jephunneh
q: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

s: Caleb will receive Canaan (land he has trodden on, because he wholly followed the LORD)
q: He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”

s: Joshua is child of Nun
q: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there.

s: Joshua will lead inheritance of Canaan (will cause Israel to inherit it)
q: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

s: Israel's rebellion at Kadesh has outcome exclusion of the generation from the promised land (except Caleb)
q: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

s: Moses defeated Sihon (king of the Amorites in Heshbon)
q: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon

s: Israel's rebellion at Kadesh stayed at Kadesh (many days)
q: So you stayed in Kadesh many days

s: Moses defeated Og (king of Bashan)
q: and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

s: Moses declares commandments, statutes, and ordinances (in the land of Moab)
q: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

s: Moses appoints judges (Israel's judges) (heads of tribes made captains and officers)
q: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

s: Moses is barred from Canaan (the LORD was angry with him for Israel's sakes)
q: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

s: Israel has size multitudinous (as the stars of the sky)
q: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

s: the LORD your God swore to give Canaan (to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and their offspring)
q: Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

s: the LORD your God is god of Israel
q: The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb

s: the LORD your God brought up Israel (out of the land of Egypt)
q: the LORD your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

s: cities far off is not among cities of the nations of Canaan
q: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

s: cities of the nations of Canaan must be utterly destroyed (nothing that breathes saved alive)
q: you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

s: cities of the nations of Canaan has inhabitant Hittite
q: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite

s: cities of the nations of Canaan has inhabitant Jebusite
q: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite

s: fruit trees is protected during siege (may be eaten, not cut down)
q: you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them.

s: fruit trees contrasts with non-food trees (non-food trees may be cut for bulwarks)
q: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down.

s: the LORD your God goes with Israel (to fight for them against enemies)
q: for the LORD your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

s: the LORD your God gives as inheritance cities of the nations of Canaan
q: But of the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance

s: the LORD your God has given plunder (plunder of enemies)
q: You may use the plunder of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

s: exemptions from battle includes new house owner (man who has not dedicated his new house)
q: What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house

s: exemptions from battle includes vineyard planter (man who has not used its fruit)
q: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house

s: exemptions from battle includes betrothed man (man who has not taken his betrothed wife)
q: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house

s: exemptions from battle includes fearful man (fearful and faint-hearted)
q: What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house

s: cities far off is treated with strike males, take plunder (males killed; women, children, livestock taken)
q: you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

s: heifer has state unworked (required condition for the ritual)
q: a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke

s: captive woman is wife of warrior/captor (after the month of mourning)
q: After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

s: captive woman may not be sold or treated as a slave (if the captor has no delight in her)
q: but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

s: man with two wives has wife hated wife (the other wife is beloved)
q: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated

s: hated wife is mother of firstborn son of the hated wife
q: if the firstborn son is hers who was hated

s: firstborn son of the hated wife has right firstborn's double portion inheritance (must be acknowledged by the father)
q: he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has

s: firstborn's double portion inheritance is a right of the firstborn (double portion of all the father has)
q: The right of the firstborn is his.

s: stubborn and rebellious son has trait disobedient to parents (does not listen even when chastened)
q: will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them

s: stubborn and rebellious son is described as glutton and drunkard (parents' accusation)
q: He is a glutton and a drunkard.

s: parents of the rebellious son bring before elders of the nearest city (to accuse the son at the gate)
q: his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place

s: man put to death and hanged is considered accursed of God (because he is hanged)
q: for he who is hanged is accursed of God

s: man put to death and hanged must be buried the same day (body not to remain overnight on the tree)
q: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day

s: elders of the nearest city provide heifer (for the ritual)
q: the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd

s: elders of the nearest city is located nearest to slain man (found in the field) (determined by measuring)
q: the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man

s: the LORD your God chooses Levi (to minister to him and bless in his name)
q: for them the LORD your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in the LORD’s name

s: the LORD your God redeems Israel
q: your people Israel, whom you have redeemed

s: the LORD your God gives Canaan (as a possession to Israel)
q: the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess

s: heifer ritual for unsolved murder purpose forgiveness of innocent blood (elders wash hands and declare innocence)
q: The blood shall be forgiven them.

s: captive woman must mourn her father and mother for a full month (before marriage to captor)
q: bewail her father and her mother a full month

s: tokens of virginity are presented to elders of the city (by the young lady's parents, at the gate)
q: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

s: elders of the city judge case at city gate (hear the accusation against the wife)
q: to the elders of the city in the gate.

s: adultery with a married woman (case) has penalty death (both the man and the woman)
q: then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman.

s: man and betrothed virgin in the city (case) has penalty stoning (both die; she did not cry out in the city)
q: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones;

s: rape of a betrothed woman in the field (case) has penalty death of the man only (the woman is not guilty)
q: then only the man who lay with her shall die;

s: unbetrothed virgin seized (case) has penalty fifty shekels of silver (paid by the man to the lady's father)
q: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver.

s: unbetrothed virgin seized (case) requires marriage (man may not divorce her all his days)
q: She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

s: lost animals and property (brother's ox, sheep, donkey, garment) must be returned to brother (the neighbor of the addressee) (kept at the finder's house until the owner seeks it)
q: You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

s: brother (the neighbor of the addressee) owns ox (may go astray or fall by the way)
q: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them.

s: brother (the neighbor of the addressee) owns donkey (may be lost or fall down)
q: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them.

s: husband (man who accuses his wife) pays fine to father of the young lady (if his accusation is proven false)
q: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady

s: husband (man who accuses his wife) fine amount one hundred shekels of silver (for giving a bad name to a virgin of Israel)
q: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel.

s: husband (man who accuses his wife) may not divorce young lady (accused wife) (all his days, after false accusation)
q: She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

s: young lady (accused wife) is wife of husband (man who accuses his wife) (given by her father)
q: I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

s: father of the young lady is father of young lady (accused wife)
q: I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

s: emasculated man is excluded from the LORD's assembly (emasculated by crushing or cutting)
q: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly.

s: the LORD your God loves Israelites (reason he turned the curse into a blessing)
q: the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.

s: Edomite may enter the LORD's assembly (children of the third generation)
q: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.

s: Egyptian may enter the LORD's assembly (children of the third generation)
q: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.

s: military camp has status holy (because the LORD walks in its middle)
q: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy

s: the LORD your God walks in military camp (to deliver Israelites and give up their enemies)
q: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you.

s: military camp has part latrine place and trowel (place outside the camp for relieving oneself)
q: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

s: ritually unclean man must stay outside military camp (until evening, after bathing)
q: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

s: person born of a forbidden union is excluded from the LORD's assembly (even to the tenth generation)
q: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD’s assembly.

s: escaped servant must not be delivered to master (of the escaped servant) (Israelites shall not return him)
q: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

s: escaped servant dwells with Israelites (in a place of his choosing, not to be oppressed)
q: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

s: prostitution is forbidden among Israelites (daughters and sons of Israel)
q: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

s: prostitution is an abomination (its hire or wages to the LORD; not allowed in the house of the LORD)
q: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.
